changeReason: Audit of v1.1 failures showed that Memora forgetting-evidence session ids identify the correction or deletion event, not the original assertion. V2 labels an obsolete atom only when its value occurs in a memory unit before that invalidation boundary; the correction event itself remains current evidence. Thresholds are unchanged.

dataset.name: Memora
dataset.sessionSequenceInvariant: Within every persona-period, numeric session_id order is non-decreasing in date (verified: 30/30 groups, zero violations).

labelAlignment.current: normalized atom value plus source-session provenance
labelAlignment.obsolete: normalized atom value in a memory unit whose sequence precedes the atom's correction/deletion session
